headline: RESCENE's Zena joins HANHAE and Moon Se-yoon on 'Love Again'
sub: A winter ballad and Zena's first feature since debut
source: Source: Brand New Music via Korean media
caption:
RESCENE's Zena teams up with rapper HANHAE and comedian Moon Se-yoon on the new single 'Love Again'!

The song dropped Nov 23 at 6 PM KST. It's a winter ballad inspired by the vintage sound of 1990s–2000s winter ballads, about running into an old love again in winter. It's the duo's fifth project single together, and Zena's first-ever feature since RESCENE debuted.

📌 Source: Brand New Music, via Korean media (Sports Kyunghyang, TenAsia)
